analysis.title: GS Kamshad - GS TMT TODAY 11.18.26
key_insights: NVDA reported FY27 3Q revenue of $115.8bn vs GS $110.1bn and Street $109.5bn. Gross margin was 74.9% vs GS 74.1% and Street 73.5%. Operating EPS was $2.68 vs GS $2.57 and Street $2.44. Stock +3% pre-market.

NVDA raised its FY28 (CY27) revenue growth forecast to 75% from 70%, vs GS prior 74% and Street 70%. The forecast already accounts for the new US Commerce Department restriction on datacenter rentals by customers to restricted geographies, including mainland China.

NVDA 4Q revenue guidance is $130bn at the midpoint vs $124.8bn for GS and the Street. Non-GAAP gross margin guide is 71.5%, below GS 72.2% and in line with the Street. Implied non-GAAP EPS guidance is $2.81 vs GS $2.88 and Street $2.67. FY4Q is a 14-week quarter.

Rubin contributed about $20bn of revenue in its first quarter shipping. NVDA says unconstrained CY27 demand growth remains well in excess of supply. GS attributes demand to new customer cohorts (AI labs, neoclouds, sovereigns) in addition to hyperscalers.

NVDA financial commitments to customers and supply chain partners total $518bn, up from $366bn last quarter. Supply chain/capacity commitments are $390bn (from $279bn), datacenter leases $74bn (from $25bn), cloud service agreements $28bn (from $29bn), equity investments $20bn (from $25bn), CapEx $6bn (from $8bn). Neocloud support commitments total $32bn.

NVDA intends to return all excess cash to shareholders, with about $227bn of remaining buyback authorization to be executed before the end of CY27. GS reads this as management viewing the stock as significantly undervalued.

NVDA management transition: co-founder Jensen Huang has resigned and Colette Kress is Interim CEO. The Board is considering internal and external candidates, has retained Heidrick & Struggles, set no timeframe, and Chairman Harvey Jones said the Board does not intend to reinstate Huang.

NVDA created a board-level National Security and Export Control Oversight Committee, continues to cooperate with government export-control investigations, and is no longer shipping permissible Hopper products to China.
NVDA balance sheet items: 3Q inventory $39.7bn (+26% QoQ), days of inventory 124 (up 4 days QoQ). Accounts receivable $81.0bn (+29% QoQ), DSO 64 days (up 4 days QoQ).

GS Prime data show hedge funds net selling global Info Tech at the fastest trailing 6-week pace in 10 years (-4.4 z score). The global Info Tech long/short ratio is 1.79 vs a YTD peak of 2.9. Info Tech is the most net sold US sector in November, led by Semis & Semi Equip shorting. US Semis net exposure fell below US Software net exposure for the first time since the start of 2026.

The SOX index is down 25% from mid-October highs and 35% from the June all-time high. Futures are mixed (Nasdaq +85bps, S&P +40bps, Russell flat) with NVDA's print expected to support AI and semiconductor sentiment.
Neocloud and AI-complex names rose pre-market after NVDA reiterated its customer support commitments: NBIS +6%, CRWV +4%, HUT +3%, IREN +5%, SMH +2.3%, DRAM +3%, Samsung +2.4%, SK Hynix +4.3%.
TTWO is +6% pre-market on positive Grand Theft Auto VI reviews (Metacritic 99). The game launches Thursday 11/19.
Tencent reported 3Q revenue and operating income misses on softer games and elevated AI spending.

Waymo (GOOGL) suspended California freeway driving after the DMV barred it from testing or operating on all freeways, citing an imminent hazard to public safety. Waymo also restricted freeway operations in its other markets. No collisions or injuries were reported in the California incidents.

GS China Internet note on the US BIS remote-access rule: future high-end compute access via rental is closed to Chinese companies, with a 90-day compliance window for existing remote-accessed compute. Frontier training at maximum scale is most exposed. Inference, applications and open-weight distribution should stay largely resilient on domestic chips. Impact varies by each company's share of rented compute outside China, and Z.AI is relatively resilient.

GS Japan note: NVDA 3Q revenue was +20% QoQ, networking revenue $21.0bn, CPU revenue expected to double in FY1/28. The Blackwell to Rubin transition is proceeding smoothly, with Vera Rubin Ultra in 2027 and Feynman in 2028.

GS views MongoDB's acquisition of Firebolt as strategically sensible, reflecting convergence of operational and analytical databases. Financial terms were not disclosed. GS sees it as an early sign that interim CEO Dev Ittycheria can keep investing during the CEO transition.
Macro snapshot: UST 10-year at 5.10% (-0.5bps), WTI -95bps at $85.20. Today's calendar has FOMC minutes, US housing starts, Eurozone CPI, UK CPI and a $16bn US 20-year auction.
Street actions: NVDA downgraded to Hold by Summit Insights, NYT downgraded to Neutral by Citi.

tension_points.bull_case: NVDA beat on revenue, gross margin and EPS, raised CY27 growth to 75% from 70%, guided 4Q revenue to $130bn vs $124.8bn Street, and plans to return all excess cash with a ~$227bn buyback. GS reads this as a boost to broader AI and semiconductor sentiment.
tension_points.bear_case: Hedge funds are selling Info Tech at the fastest 6-week pace in 10 years (-4.4 z score), the SOX is -25% from mid-October highs, and NVDA's commitments rose to $518bn from $366bn. Inventory (+26% QoQ) and receivables (+29% QoQ) are growing, CEO succession is unresolved, and export restrictions remain.
